answer: Crane-slot licenses wait on a filmed rebound drop. An applicant stakes 30 coins and lowers a clerk-serialized 9 kg comet weight from crane 4 of licensed wharf 11, whose limestone karst sockets are posted on the berth map. For 10 minutes they film the weight's rebound every 6 s against that map. Peers accept only when the comet lot is in each still, rebound is within 4 cm of the table, and the socket tag matches pier 11. A tank mock or reused weight burns the stake, so one berth cannot underwrite a crowd of aliases.
